reason: A DSH plugin whose primary user-facing purpose is playing Gomoku against configured AI models or watching two AI models play through an interactive board.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 中提供可与 AI 对弈或让两个 AI 对战的 15×15 五子棋棋盘，并支持编辑双方提示词与查看思考过程。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive 15×15 Gomoku board to DSH for human-versus-AI or AI-versus-AI matches, with editable player prompts and displayed reasoning.

capabilities: Provides an interactive 15×15 Gomoku board in the DSH interface
Sends board state, edited system prompts, model selection, and reasoning settings to configured AI models
Displays returned AI reasoning and validates AI moves
Stores game state in the browser and retries transient streaming failures
